cases.headline: PCG moved from operating profit to operating loss as revenue contracted
cases.claim: PCG's FY2025 operating performance is an exception worth investigation.
cases.rationale: The reported figures establish the size and direction of the swing, but Proofline does not infer a cause. The case is uncertain as to cause and prompts human investigation; the underlying arithmetic is source-supported.
cases.suggested_investigation: Review PCG's operating-expense, impairment, foreign-exchange, segment, and joint-operation disclosures before attributing the margin swing.

cases.claim: Revenue for FY2025 stood at RM27.5 billion.
cases.tolerance: RM50 million, the half-unit rounding interval for one-decimal RM billions
cases.rationale: RM27,480 million rounds to RM27.5 billion at the claim's display precision, so the release and audited statement agree.
